mapper.update: UPDATE service_reservation SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE status = 0 AND ( reservation_date < CURRENT_DATE OR (reservation_date = CURRENT_DATE AND end_time < CURRENT_TIME) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM service_reservation WHERE status = 0 AND ( reservation_date < CURRENT_DATE OR (reservation_date = CURRENT_DATE AND end_time < CURRENT_TIME) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_reservation (student_id, device_id, reservation_date, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{deviceId}, #{reservationDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.building_no AS deviceBuildingNo FROM service_reservation r LEFT JOIN device_resource d ON r.device_id = d.id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.building_no AS deviceBuildingNo, s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo FROM service_reservation r LEFT JOIN device_resource d ON r.device_id = d.id LEFT JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.id
AND r.status = #{status}
AND s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{studentNo}, '%')
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM service_reservation WHERE status = 0 AND reservation_date = CURRENT_DATE AND start_time BETWEEN CURTIME() AND ADDTIME(CURTIME(), '00:15:00')
